evidence: Reads attribute-context selector 0x13 via attribute_context_status_value_get, branches on returned values 3, 4, and zero, then returns one of two computed result codes (30 or 83) based on subsequent selector-0x13 checks. The exact business meaning of those result codes is unknown. decompiled/main/main_0170.c:5373-5412; caller process_attribute_candidate_set invokes this and consumes the returned integer at decompiled/main/main_0054.c:41635-41637.

Requires non-null second argument and a nonzero byte at first-argument offset 0x428. Reads the pointer at second-argument offset 8, obtains nested attribute selector 0x32 as a float, converts to signed int, returns 5 above 4, returns the integer when nonnegative and at most 4, or -2 for negative/missing input. decompiled/main/main_0112.c:35380-35411.

Requires non-null second argument and nonzero byte at first-argument offset 0x428. Calls helper f_700183ac90 with the second argument and an output pointer; on success reads nested attribute selector 0x1b as float, converts to signed int, and returns 3 for values above 2, the value for 0..2, or -2 for negative/missing/error cases. decompiled/main/main_0116.c:13970-14004.

Queries attribute-context status selector 0x14 and only runs the loop when it equals 4. Iterates candidate indices 0 through 29, checks each with f_700076c200, and for qualifying indices calls f_7000709848/f_7000709c28; it also repeats f_700076c360(index, 1) while that helper returns true. Called from sort_and_filter_attribute_candidates_then_call_followup_and_return_zero. Exact roles of the address-only helpers remain unknown. decompiled/main/main_0054.c:25731-25757; caller decompiled/main/main_0058.c:16347-16354.

With non-null second argument, calls convert_attribute_value_to_float_div_100 using that pointer and the third-argument value, then classifies the resulting float into six ordered buckets using thresholds 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9 (return values 0 through 5). Null input returns -2. The routine preserves/restores SIMD registers used for comparisons. decompiled/main/main_0119.c:15717-15762; caller passes its x19/x21 values and stores the returned bucket at decompiled/main/main_0116.c:41299-41304.
